verdicts.reason: finalize_pkvm drops host privileges irreversibly; perform_access injects undefined on hidden regs and increments PC only when r->access succeeds.
kvm_arch_vcpu_ioctl gates reg ops on initialization/finalization; kvm_arch_vm_ioctl gates on pKVM policy; handle___kvm_vcpu_run acts as the hyp vCPU run shim.
get_asid_by_regime BUGs on bad regime, stage2_map_walk_leaf returns -EAGAIN to retry, and hyp_trace_load safely cleans up, but __gic_v3_get_lr masks lr with 0xf so bad LR is not fatal.
pKVM unlinked/split stubs WARN, kvm_arch_flush_shadow_all warns on non-zero refcnt, and s2_mmu_unmap_range can block, but gmem_abort shows standard fault exit prep, not poison handling.

overall: Findings 5 and 6 are fully supported by the fragments. Finding 7 overstates __gic_v3_get_lr fatality (it masks lr & 0xf before switching), and Finding 8's 'faults poison' claim is not supported by gmem_abort.
